text: {"text":"Hi {first_name}, this is {clinic_name}. We wrote to you before about a follow-up visit. We have not heard back yet, so we wanted to check in. Please book your visit by {due_by}. You can call us at {clinic_phone}. We are glad to help you find a time that works. If you do not want these reminders, you can stop them here: {opt_out_link}. Thank you."}
